sections.label: First Adhyaya
sections.name: What is the cause? The wheel of Brahman
intro: The Svetasvatara belongs to the Black Yajur Veda and is the most theistic of the principal Upanishads: it names Rudra, the blessed Siva, as the one God who creates and rules the world, dwells hidden in all beings and is known in the heart. Beside the Vedanta it draws on early ideas of Sankhya, gives one of the oldest descriptions of the practice of Yoga, and in its last verse speaks of the highest devotion (bhakti) to God, and to one's Guru as to God.

verses.sa:
ॐ ब्रह्मवादिनो वदन्ति ।
किं कारणं ब्रह्म कुतः स्म जाता जीवाम केन क्व च सम्प्रतिष्ठा ।
अधिष्ठिताः केन सुखेतरेषु वर्तामहे ब्रह्मविदो व्यवस्थाम् ॥
verses.tr:
oṃ brahmavādino vadanti
kiṃ kāraṇaṃ brahma kutaḥ sma jātā jīvāma kena kva ca sampratiṣṭhā
adhiṣṭhitāḥ kena sukhetareṣu vartāmahe brahmavido vyavasthām
verses.en: The Brahma-students say: Is Brahman the cause? Whence are we born? Whereby do we live, and whither do we go? O ye who know Brahman, (tell us) at whose command we abide, whether in pain or in pleasure?

verses.sa:
कालः स्वभावो नियतिर्यदृच्छा भूतानि योनिः पुरुष इति चिन्त्यम् ।
संयोग एषां न त्वात्मभावादात्माप्यनीशः सुखदुःखहेतोः ॥
verses.tr:
kālaḥ svabhāvo niyatiryadṛcchā bhūtāni yoniḥ puruṣa iti cintyam
saṃyoga eṣāṃ na tvātmabhāvādātmāpyanīśaḥ sukhaduḥkhahetoḥ
verses.en: Should time, or nature, or necessity, or chance, or the elements be considered as the cause, or he who is called the person (purusha, vijnanatma)? It cannot be their union either, because that is not self-dependent, and the self also is powerless, because there is (independent of him) a cause of good and evil.

verses.sa:
ते ध्यानयोगानुगता अपश्यन्देवात्मशक्तिं स्वगुणैर्निगूढाम् ।
यः कारणानि निखिलानि तानि कालात्मयुक्तान्यधितिष्ठत्येकः ॥
verses.tr:
te dhyānayogānugatā apaśyandevātmaśaktiṃ svaguṇairnigūḍhām
yaḥ kāraṇāni nikhilāni tāni kālātmayuktānyadhitiṣṭhatyekaḥ
verses.en: The sages, devoted to meditation and concentration, have seen the power belonging to God himself, hidden in its own qualities (guna). He, being one, superintends all those causes, time, self, and the rest.

verses.sa:
तमेकनेमिं त्रिवृतं षोडशान्तं शतार्धारं विंशतिप्रत्यराभिः ।
अष्टकैः षड्भिर्विश्वरूपैकपाशं त्रिमार्गभेदं द्विनिमित्तैकमोहम् ॥
verses.tr:
tamekanemiṃ trivṛtaṃ ṣoḍaśāntaṃ śatārdhāraṃ viṃśatipratyarābhiḥ
aṣṭakaiḥ ṣaḍbhirviśvarūpaikapāśaṃ trimārgabhedaṃ dvinimittaikamoham
verses.en: We meditate on him who (like a wheel) has one felly with three tires, sixteen ends, fifty spokes, with twenty counter-spokes, and six sets of eight; whose one rope is manifold, who proceeds on three different roads, and whose illusion arises from two causes.

verses.sa:
पञ्चस्रोतोम्बुं पञ्चयोन्युग्रवक्त्रां पञ्चप्राणोर्मिं पञ्चबुद्ध्यादिमूलाम् ।
पञ्चावर्तां पञ्चदुःखौघवेगां पञ्चाशद्भेदां पञ्चपर्वामधीमः ॥
verses.tr:
pañcasrotombuṃ pañcayonyugravaktrāṃ pañcaprāṇormiṃ pañcabuddhyādimūlām
pañcāvartāṃ pañcaduḥkhaughavegāṃ pañcāśadbhedāṃ pañcaparvāmadhīmaḥ
verses.en: We meditate on the river whose water consists of the five streams, which is wild and winding with its five springs, whose waves are the five vital breaths, whose fountain head is the mind, the course of the five kinds of perceptions. It has five whirlpools, its rapids are the five pains; it has fifty kinds of suffering, and five branches.

verses.sa:
सर्वाजीवे सर्वसंस्थे बृहन्ते तस्मिन्हंसो भ्राम्यते ब्रह्मचक्रे ।
पृथगात्मानं प्रेरितारं च मत्वा जुष्टस्ततस्तेनामृतत्वमेति ॥
verses.tr:
sarvājīve sarvasaṃsthe bṛhante tasminhaṃso bhrāmyate brahmacakre
pṛthagātmānaṃ preritāraṃ ca matvā juṣṭastatastenāmṛtatvameti
verses.en: In that vast Brahma-wheel, in which all things live and rest, the bird flutters about, so long as he thinks that the self (in him) is different from the mover (the god, the lord). When he has been blessed by him, then he gains immortality.

verses.sa:
उद्गीतमेतत्परमं तु ब्रह्म तस्मिंस्त्रयं सुप्रतिष्ठाऽक्षरं च ।
अत्रान्तरं ब्रह्मविदो विदित्वा लीना ब्रह्मणि तत्परा योनिमुक्ताः ॥
verses.tr:
udgītametatparamaṃ tu brahma tasmiṃstrayaṃ supratiṣṭhā'kṣaraṃ ca
atrāntaraṃ brahmavido viditvā līnā brahmaṇi tatparā yonimuktāḥ
verses.en: But what is praised (in the Upanishads) is the Highest Brahman, and in it there is the triad. The Highest Brahman is the safe support, it is imperishable. The Brahma-students, when they have known what is within this (world), are devoted and merged in the Brahman, free from birth.

verses.sa:
संयुक्तमेतत्क्षरमक्षरं च व्यक्ताव्यक्तं भरते विश्वमीशः ।
अनीशश्चात्मा बध्यते भोक्तृभावाज्ज्ञात्वा देवं मुच्यते सर्वपाशैः ॥
verses.tr:
saṃyuktametatkṣaramakṣaraṃ ca vyaktāvyaktaṃ bharate viśvamīśaḥ
anīśaścātmā badhyate bhoktṛbhāvājjñātvā devaṃ mucyate sarvapāśaiḥ
verses.en: The Lord (isa) supports all this together, the perishable and the imperishable, the developed and the undeveloped. The (living) self, not being a lord, is bound, because he has to enjoy (the fruits of works); but when he has known the god (deva), he is freed from all fetters.

verses.sa:
ज्ञाज्ञौ द्वावजावीशनीशावजा ह्येका भोक्तृभोग्यार्थयुक्ता ।
अनन्तश्चात्मा विश्वरूपो ह्यकर्ता त्रयं यदा विन्दते ब्रह्ममेतत् ॥
verses.tr:
jñājñau dvāvajāvīśanīśāvajā hyekā bhoktṛbhogyārthayuktā
anantaścātmā viśvarūpo hyakartā trayaṃ yadā vindate brahmametat
verses.en: There are two, one knowing (isvara), the other not-knowing (jiva), both unborn, one strong, the other weak; there is she, the unborn, through whom each man receives the recompense of his works; and there is the infinite Self (appearing) under all forms, but himself inactive. When a man finds out these three, that is Brahma.

verses.sa:
क्षरं प्रधानममृताक्षरं हरः क्षरात्मानावीशते देव एकः ।
तस्याभिध्यानाद्योजनात्तत्त्वभावाद्भूयश्चान्ते विश्वमायानिवृत्तिः ॥
verses.tr:
kṣaraṃ pradhānamamṛtākṣaraṃ haraḥ kṣarātmānāvīśate deva ekaḥ
tasyābhidhyānādyojanāttattvabhāvādbhūyaścānte viśvamāyānivṛttiḥ
verses.en: That which is perishable is the Pradhana (the first), the immortal and imperishable is Hara. The one god rules the perishable (the pradhana) and the (living) self. From meditating on him, from joining him, from becoming one with him there is further cessation of all illusion in the end.

verses.sa:
ज्ञात्वा देवं सर्वपाशापहानिः क्षीणैः क्लेशैर्जन्ममृत्युप्रहाणिः ।
तस्याभिध्यानात्तृतीयं देहभेदे विश्वैश्वर्यं केवल आप्तकामः ॥
verses.tr:
jñātvā devaṃ sarvapāśāpahāniḥ kṣīṇaiḥ kleśairjanmamṛtyuprahāṇiḥ
tasyābhidhyānāttṛtīyaṃ dehabhede viśvaiśvaryaṃ kevala āptakāmaḥ
verses.en: When that god is known, all fetters fall off, sufferings are destroyed, and birth and death cease. From meditating on him there arises, on the dissolution of the body, the third state, that of universal lordship; but he only who is alone, is satisfied.

verses.sa:
एतज्ज्ञेयं नित्यमेवात्मसंस्थं नातः परं वेदितव्यं हि किञ्चित् ।
भोक्ता भोग्यं प्रेरितारं च मत्वा सर्वं प्रोक्तं त्रिविधं ब्रह्ममेतत् ॥
verses.tr:
etajjñeyaṃ nityamevātmasaṃsthaṃ nātaḥ paraṃ veditavyaṃ hi kiñcit
bhoktā bhogyaṃ preritāraṃ ca matvā sarvaṃ proktaṃ trividhaṃ brahmametat
verses.en: This, which rests eternally within the self, should be known; and beyond this not anything has to be known. By knowing the enjoyer, the enjoyed, and the ruler, everything has been declared to be threefold, and this is Brahman.

verses.sa:
वह्नेर्यथा योनिगतस्य मूर्तिर्न दृश्यते नैव च लिङ्गनाशः ।
स भूय एवेन्धनयोनिगृह्यस्तद्वोभयं वै प्रणवेन देहे ॥
verses.tr:
vahneryathā yonigatasya mūrtirna dṛśyate naiva ca liṅganāśaḥ
sa bhūya evendhanayonigṛhyastadvobhayaṃ vai praṇavena dehe
verses.en: As the form of fire, while it exists in the under-wood, is not seen, nor is its seed destroyed, but it has to be seized again and again by means of the stick and the under-wood, so it is in both cases, and the Self has to be seized in the body by means of the pranava (the syllable Om).

verses.sa:
स्वदेहमरणिं कृत्वा प्रणवं चोत्तरारणिम् ।
ध्याननिर्मथनाभ्यासाद्देवं पश्यन्निगूढवत् ॥
verses.tr:
svadehamaraṇiṃ kṛtvā praṇavaṃ cottarāraṇim
dhyānanirmathanābhyāsāddevaṃ paśyannigūḍhavat
verses.en: By making his body the under-wood, and the syllable Om the upper-wood, man, after repeating the drill of meditation, will perceive the bright god, like the spark hidden in the wood.

verses.sa:
तिलेषु तैलं दधिनीव सर्पिरापः स्रोतःस्वरणीषु चाग्निः ।
एवमात्माऽत्मनि गृह्यतेऽसौ सत्येनैनं तपसा योऽनुपश्यति ॥
verses.tr:
tileṣu tailaṃ dadhinīva sarpirāpaḥ srotaḥsvaraṇīṣu cāgniḥ
evamātmā'tmani gṛhyate'sau satyenainaṃ tapasā yo'nupaśyati
verses.en: As oil in seeds, as butter in cream, as water in (dry) river-beds, as fire in wood, so is the Self seized within the self, if man looks for him by truthfulness and penance;

verses.sa:
सर्वव्यापिनमात्मानं क्षीरे सर्पिरिवार्पितम् ।
आत्मविद्यातपोमूलं तद्ब्रह्मोपनिषत्परं तद्ब्रह्मोपनिषत्परमिति ॥
verses.tr:
sarvavyāpinamātmānaṃ kṣīre sarpirivārpitam
ātmavidyātapomūlaṃ tadbrahmopaniṣatparaṃ tadbrahmopaniṣatparamiti
verses.en: (If he looks) for the Self that pervades everything, as butter is contained in milk, and the roots whereof are self-knowledge and penance. That is the Brahman taught by the Upanishad.

verses.sa:
युञ्जानः प्रथमं मनस्तत्त्वाय सविता धियः ।
अग्नेर्ज्योतिर्निचाय्य पृथिव्या अध्याभरत् ॥
verses.tr:
yuñjānaḥ prathamaṃ manastattvāya savitā dhiyaḥ
agnerjyotirnicāyya pṛthivyā adhyābharat
verses.en: Savitri (the sun), having first collected his mind and expanded his thoughts, brought Agni (fire), when he had discovered his light, above the earth.

verses.sa:
युक्तेन मनसा वयं देवस्य सवितुः सवे ।
सुवर्गेयाय शक्त्या ॥
verses.tr:
yuktena manasā vayaṃ devasya savituḥ save
suvargeyāya śaktyā
verses.en: With collected minds we are at the command of the divine Savitri, that we may obtain blessedness.

verses.sa:
युक्त्वाय मनसा देवान् सुवर्यतो धिया दिवम् ।
बृहज्ज्योतिः करिष्यतः सविता प्रसुवाति तान् ॥
verses.tr:
yuktvāya manasā devān suvaryato dhiyā divam
bṛhajjyotiḥ kariṣyataḥ savitā prasuvāti tān
verses.en: May Savitri, after he has reached with his mind the gods as they rise up to the sky, and with his thoughts (has reached) heaven, grant these gods to make a great light to shine.

verses.sa:
युञ्जते मन उत युञ्जते धियो विप्रा विप्रस्य बृहतो विपश्चितः ।
विहोत्रा दधे वयुनाविदेक इन्मही देवस्य सवितुः परिष्टुतिः ॥
verses.tr:
yuñjate mana uta yuñjate dhiyo viprā viprasya bṛhato vipaścitaḥ
vihotrā dadhe vayunāvideka inmahī devasya savituḥ pariṣṭutiḥ
verses.en: The wise sages of the great sage collect their mind and collect their thoughts. He who alone knows the law (Savitri) has ordered the invocations; great is the praise of the divine Savitri.

verses.sa:
युजे वां ब्रह्म पूर्व्यं नमोभिर्विश्लोक एतु पथ्येव सूरेः ।
शृण्वन्तु विश्वे अमृतस्य पुत्रा आ ये धामानि दिव्यानि तस्थुः ॥
verses.tr:
yuje vāṃ brahma pūrvyaṃ namobhirviśloka etu pathyeva sūreḥ
śṛṇvantu viśve amṛtasya putrā ā ye dhāmāni divyāni tasthuḥ
verses.en: Your old prayer has to be joined with praises. Let my song go forth like the path of the sun! May all the sons of the Immortal listen, they who have reached their heavenly homes.

verses.sa:
अग्निर्यत्राभिमथ्यते वायुर्यत्राधिरुध्यते ।
सोमो यत्रातिरिच्यते तत्र सञ्जायते मनः ॥
verses.tr:
agniryatrābhimathyate vāyuryatrādhirudhyate
somo yatrātiricyate tatra sañjāyate manaḥ
verses.en: Where the fire is rubbed, where the wind is checked, where the Soma flows over, there the mind is born.

verses.sa:
सवित्रा प्रसवेन जुषेत ब्रह्म पूर्व्यम् ।
यत्र योनिं कृणवसे न हि ते पूर्तमक्षिपत् ॥
verses.tr:
savitrā prasavena juṣeta brahma pūrvyam
yatra yoniṃ kṛṇavase na hi te pūrtamakṣipat
verses.en: Let us love the old Brahman by the grace of Savitri; if thou make thy dwelling there, the path will not hurt thee.

verses.sa:
त्रिरुन्नतं स्थाप्य समं शरीरं हृदीन्द्रियाणि मनसा सन्निवेश्य ।
ब्रह्मोडुपेन प्रतरेत विद्वान्स्रोतांसि सर्वाणि भयानकानि ॥
verses.tr:
trirunnataṃ sthāpya samaṃ śarīraṃ hṛdīndriyāṇi manasā sanniveśya
brahmoḍupena pratareta vidvānsrotāṃsi sarvāṇi bhayānakāni
verses.en: If a wise man hold his body with its three erect parts (chest, neck, and head) even, and turn his senses with the mind towards the heart, he will then in the boat of Brahman cross all the torrents which cause fear.

verses.sa:
प्राणान्प्रपीड्येह स युक्तचेष्टः क्षीणे प्राणे नासिकयोच्छ्वसीत ।
दुष्टाश्वयुक्तमिव वाहमेनं विद्वान्मनो धारयेताप्रमत्तः ॥
verses.tr:
prāṇānprapīḍyeha sa yuktaceṣṭaḥ kṣīṇe prāṇe nāsikayocchvasīta
duṣṭāśvayuktamiva vāhamenaṃ vidvānmano dhārayetāpramattaḥ
verses.en: Compressing his breathings let him, who has subdued all motions, breathe forth through the nose with gentle breath. Let the wise man without fail restrain his mind, that chariot yoked with vicious horses.

verses.sa:
समे शुचौ शर्करावह्निवालुकाविवर्जिते शब्दजलाश्रयादिभिः ।
मनोनुकूले न तु चक्षुपीडने गुहानिवाताश्रयणे प्रयोजयेत् ॥
verses.tr:
same śucau śarkarāvahnivālukāvivarjite śabdajalāśrayādibhiḥ
manonukūle na tu cakṣupīḍane guhānivātāśrayaṇe prayojayet
verses.en: Let him perform his exercises in a place level, pure, free from pebbles, fire, and dust, delightful by its sounds, its water, and bowers, not painful to the eye, and full of shelters and caves.

verses.sa:
नीहारधूमार्कानिलानलानां खद्योतविद्युत्स्फटिकशशीनाम् ।
एतानि रूपाणि पुरःसराणि ब्रह्मण्यभिव्यक्तिकराणि योगे ॥
verses.tr:
nīhāradhūmārkānilānalānāṃ khadyotavidyutsphaṭikaśaśīnām
etāni rūpāṇi puraḥsarāṇi brahmaṇyabhivyaktikarāṇi yoge
verses.en: When Yoga is being performed, the forms which come first, producing apparitions in Brahman, are those of misty smoke, sun, fire, wind, fire-flies, lightnings, and a crystal moon.

verses.sa:
पृथिव्यप्तेजोऽनिलखे समुत्थिते पञ्चात्मके योगगुणे प्रवृत्ते ।
न तस्य रोगो न जरा न मृत्युः प्राप्तस्य योगाग्निमयं शरीरम् ॥
verses.tr:
pṛthivyaptejo'nilakhe samutthite pañcātmake yogaguṇe pravṛtte
na tasya rogo na jarā na mṛtyuḥ prāptasya yogāgnimayaṃ śarīram
verses.en: When, as earth, water, light, heat, and ether arise, the fivefold quality of Yoga takes place, then there is no longer illness, old age, or pains for him who has obtained a body, produced by the fire of Yoga.

verses.sa:
लघुत्वमारोग्यमलोलुपत्वं वर्णप्रसादं स्वरसौष्ठवं च ।
गन्धः शुभो मूत्रपुरीषमल्पं योगप्रवृत्तिं प्रथमां वदन्ति ॥
verses.tr:
laghutvamārogyamalolupatvaṃ varṇaprasādaṃ svarasauṣṭhavaṃ ca
gandhaḥ śubho mūtrapurīṣamalpaṃ yogapravṛttiṃ prathamāṃ vadanti
verses.en: The first results of Yoga they call lightness, healthiness, steadiness, a good complexion, an easy pronunciation, a sweet odour, and slight excretions.

verses.sa:
यथैव बिम्बं मृदयोपलिप्तं तेजोमयं भ्राजते तत्सुधान्तम् ।
तद्वाऽऽत्मतत्त्वं प्रसमीक्ष्य देही एकः कृतार्थो भवते वीतशोकः ॥
verses.tr:
yathaiva bimbaṃ mṛdayopaliptaṃ tejomayaṃ bhrājate tatsudhāntam
tadvā''tmatattvaṃ prasamīkṣya dehī ekaḥ kṛtārtho bhavate vītaśokaḥ
verses.en: As a metal disk (mirror), tarnished by dust, shines bright again after it has been cleaned, so is the one incarnate person satisfied and free from grief, after he has seen the real nature of the self.

verses.sa:
यदात्मतत्त्वेन तु ब्रह्मतत्त्वं दीपोपमेनेह युक्तः प्रपश्येत् ।
अजं ध्रुवं सर्वतत्त्वैर्विशुद्धं ज्ञात्वा देवं मुच्यते सर्वपापैः ॥
verses.tr:
yadātmatattvena tu brahmatattvaṃ dīpopameneha yuktaḥ prapaśyet
ajaṃ dhruvaṃ sarvatattvairviśuddhaṃ jñātvā devaṃ mucyate sarvapāpaiḥ
verses.en: And when by means of the real nature of his self he sees, as by a lamp, the real nature of Brahman, then having known the unborn, eternal god, who is beyond all natures, he is freed from all fetters.

verses.sa:
एषो ह देवः प्रदिशोऽनु सर्वाः पूर्वो ह जातः स उ गर्भे अन्तः ।
स एव जातः स जनिष्यमाणः प्रत्यङ्जनास्तिष्ठति सर्वतोमुखः ॥
verses.tr:
eṣo ha devaḥ pradiśo'nu sarvāḥ pūrvo ha jātaḥ sa u garbhe antaḥ
sa eva jātaḥ sa janiṣyamāṇaḥ pratyaṅjanāstiṣṭhati sarvatomukhaḥ
verses.en: He indeed is the god who pervades all regions: he is the first-born (as Hiranyagarbha), and he is in the womb. He has been born, and he will be born. He stands behind all persons, looking everywhere.

verses.sa:
यो देवोऽग्नौ योऽप्सु यो विश्वं भुवनमाविवेश ।
य ओषधीषु यो वनस्पतिषु तस्मै देवाय नमो नमः ॥
verses.tr:
yo devo'gnau yo'psu yo viśvaṃ bhuvanamāviveśa
ya oṣadhīṣu yo vanaspatiṣu tasmai devāya namo namaḥ
verses.en: The god who is in the fire, the god who is in the water, the god who has entered into the whole world, the god who is in plants, the god who is in trees, adoration be to that god, adoration!

sections.label: Third Adhyaya
sections.name: Rudra, the one God; the Person beyond darkness

verses.sa:
य एको जालवानीशत ईशनीभिः सर्वांल्लोकानीशत ईशनीभिः ।
य एवैक उद्भवे सम्भवे च य एतद्विदुरमृतास्ते भवन्ति ॥
verses.tr:
ya eko jālavānīśata īśanībhiḥ sarvāṃllokānīśata īśanībhiḥ
ya evaika udbhave sambhave ca ya etadviduramṛtāste bhavanti
verses.en: The snarer who rules alone by his powers, who rules all the worlds by his powers, who is one and the same, while things arise and exist,—they who know this are immortal.

verses.sa:
एको हि रुद्रो न द्वितीयाय तस्थुर्य इमांल्लोकानीशत ईशनीभिः ।
प्रत्यङ्जनास्तिष्ठति सञ्चुकोचान्तकाले संसृज्य विश्वा भुवनानि गोपाः ॥
verses.tr:
eko hi rudro na dvitīyāya tasthurya imāṃllokānīśata īśanībhiḥ
pratyaṅjanāstiṣṭhati sañcukocāntakāle saṃsṛjya viśvā bhuvanāni gopāḥ
verses.en: For there is one Rudra only, they do not allow a second, who rules all the worlds by his powers. He stands behind all persons, and after having created all worlds he, the protector, rolls it up at the end of time.

verses.sa:
विश्वतश्चक्षुरुत विश्वतोमुखो विश्वतोबाहुरुत विश्वतस्पात् ।
सम्बाहुभ्यां धमति सम्पतत्रैर्द्यावाभूमी जनयन्देव एकः ॥
verses.tr:
viśvataścakṣuruta viśvatomukho viśvatobāhuruta viśvataspāt
sambāhubhyāṃ dhamati sampatatrairdyāvābhūmī janayandeva ekaḥ
verses.en: That one god, having his eyes, his face, his arms, and his feet in every place, when producing heaven and earth, forges them together with his arms and his wings.

verses.sa:
यो देवानां प्रभवश्चोद्भवश्च विश्वाधिपो रुद्रो महर्षिः ।
हिरण्यगर्भं जनयामास पूर्वं स नो बुद्ध्या शुभया संयुनक्तु ॥
verses.tr:
yo devānāṃ prabhavaścodbhavaśca viśvādhipo rudro maharṣiḥ
hiraṇyagarbhaṃ janayāmāsa pūrvaṃ sa no buddhyā śubhayā saṃyunaktu
verses.en: He, the creator and supporter of the gods, Rudra, the great seer, the lord of all, he who formerly gave birth to Hiranyagarbha, may he endow us with good thoughts.

verses.sa:
या ते रुद्रा शिवा तनूरघोराऽपापकाशिनी ।
तया नस्तनुवा शन्तमया गिरिशन्ताभिचाकशीहि ॥
verses.tr:
yā te rudrā śivā tanūraghorā'pāpakāśinī
tayā nastanuvā śantamayā giriśantābhicākaśīhi
verses.en: O Rudra, thou dweller in the mountains, look upon us with that most blessed form of thine which is auspicious, not terrible, and reveals no evil!

verses.sa:
यामिषुं गिरिशन्त हस्ते बिभर्ष्यस्तवे ।
शिवां गिरित्र तां कुरु मा हिंसीः पुरुषं जगत् ॥
verses.tr:
yāmiṣuṃ giriśanta haste bibharṣyastave
śivāṃ giritra tāṃ kuru mā hiṃsīḥ puruṣaṃ jagat
verses.en: O lord of the mountains, make lucky that arrow which thou, a dweller in the mountains, holdest in thy hand to shoot. Do not hurt man or beast!

verses.sa:
ततः परं ब्रह्म परं बृहन्तं यथा निकायं सर्वभूतेषु गूढम् ।
विश्वस्यैकं परिवेष्टितारमीशं तं ज्ञात्वाऽमृता भवन्ति ॥
verses.tr:
tataḥ paraṃ brahma paraṃ bṛhantaṃ yathā nikāyaṃ sarvabhūteṣu gūḍham
viśvasyaikaṃ pariveṣṭitāramīśaṃ taṃ jñātvā'mṛtā bhavanti
verses.en: Those who know beyond this the High Brahman, the vast, hidden in the bodies of all creatures, and alone enveloping everything, as the Lord, they become immortal.

verses.sa:
वेदाहमेतं पुरुषं महान्तमादित्यवर्णं तमसः परस्तात् ।
तमेव विदित्वातिमृत्युमेति नान्यः पन्था विद्यतेऽयनाय ॥
verses.tr:
vedāhametaṃ puruṣaṃ mahāntamādityavarṇaṃ tamasaḥ parastāt
tameva viditvātimṛtyumeti nānyaḥ panthā vidyate'yanāya
verses.en: I know that great person (purusha) of sunlike lustre beyond the darkness. A man who knows him truly, passes over death; there is no other path to go.

verses.sa:
यस्मात्परं नापरमस्ति किंचिद्यस्मान्नाणीयो न ज्यायोऽस्ति कश्चित् ।
वृक्ष इव स्तब्धो दिवि तिष्ठत्येकस्तेनेदं पूर्णं पुरुषेण सर्वम् ॥
verses.tr:
yasmātparaṃ nāparamasti kiṃcidyasmānnāṇīyo na jyāyo'sti kaścit
vṛkṣa iva stabdho divi tiṣṭhatyekastenedaṃ pūrṇaṃ puruṣeṇa sarvam
verses.en: This whole universe is filled by this person (purusha), to whom there is nothing superior, from whom there is nothing different, than whom there is nothing smaller or larger, who stands alone, fixed like a tree in the sky.

verses.sa:
ततो यदुत्तरतरं तदरूपमनामयम् ।
य एतद्विदुरमृतास्ते भवन्त्यथेतरे दुःखमेवापियन्ति ॥
verses.tr:
tato yaduttarataraṃ tadarūpamanāmayam
ya etadviduramṛtāste bhavantyathetare duḥkhamevāpiyanti
verses.en: That which is beyond this world is without form and without suffering. They who know it, become immortal, but others suffer pain indeed.

verses.sa:
सर्वाननशिरोग्रीवः सर्वभूतगुहाशयः ।
सर्वव्यापी स भगवांस्तस्मात्सर्वगतः शिवः ॥
verses.tr:
sarvānanaśirogrīvaḥ sarvabhūtaguhāśayaḥ
sarvavyāpī sa bhagavāṃstasmātsarvagataḥ śivaḥ
verses.en: That Bhagavat exists in the faces, the heads, the necks of all, he dwells in the cave (of the heart) of all beings, he is all-pervading, therefore he is the omnipresent Siva.

verses.sa:
महान्प्रभुर्वै पुरुषः सत्त्वस्यैष प्रवर्तकः ।
सुनिर्मलामिमां प्राप्तिमीशानो ज्योतिरव्ययः ॥
verses.tr:
mahānprabhurvai puruṣaḥ sattvasyaiṣa pravartakaḥ
sunirmalāmimāṃ prāptimīśāno jyotiravyayaḥ
verses.en: That person (purusha) is the great lord; he is the mover of existence, he possesses that purest power of reaching everything, he is light, he is undecaying.

verses.sa:
अङ्गुष्ठमात्रः पुरुषोऽन्तरात्मा सदा जनानां हृदये सन्निविष्टः ।
हृदा मनीषा मनसाभिक्लृप्तो य एतद्विदुरमृतास्ते भवन्ति ॥
verses.tr:
aṅguṣṭhamātraḥ puruṣo'ntarātmā sadā janānāṃ hṛdaye sanniviṣṭaḥ
hṛdā manīṣā manasābhiklṛpto ya etadviduramṛtāste bhavanti
verses.en: The person (purusha), not larger than a thumb, dwelling within, always dwelling in the heart of man, is perceived by the heart, the thought, the mind; they who know it become immortal.

verses.sa:
सहस्रशीर्षा पुरुषः सहस्राक्षः सहस्रपात् ।
स भूमिं विश्वतो वृत्वाऽत्यतिष्ठद्दशाङ्गुलम् ॥
verses.tr:
sahasraśīrṣā puruṣaḥ sahasrākṣaḥ sahasrapāt
sa bhūmiṃ viśvato vṛtvā'tyatiṣṭhaddaśāṅgulam
verses.en: The person (purusha) with a thousand heads, a thousand eyes, a thousand feet, having compassed the earth on every side, extends beyond it by ten fingers breadth.

verses.sa:
पुरुष एवेदँ सर्वं यद्भूतं यच्च भव्यम् ।
उतामृतत्वस्येशानो यदन्नेनातिरोहति ॥
verses.tr:
puruṣa evedam̐ sarvaṃ yadbhūtaṃ yacca bhavyam
utāmṛtatvasyeśāno yadannenātirohati
verses.en: That person alone (purusha) is all this, what has been and what will be; he is also the lord of immortality; he is whatever grows by food.

verses.sa:
सर्वतः पाणिपादं तत्सर्वतोऽक्षिशिरोमुखम् ।
सर्वतः श्रुतिमल्लोके सर्वमावृत्य तिष्ठति ॥
verses.tr:
sarvataḥ pāṇipādaṃ tatsarvato'kṣiśiromukham
sarvataḥ śrutimalloke sarvamāvṛtya tiṣṭhati
verses.en: Its hands and feet are everywhere, its eyes and head are everywhere, its ears are everywhere, it stands encompassing all in the world.

verses.sa:
सर्वेन्द्रियगुणाभासं सर्वेन्द्रियविवर्जितम् ।
सर्वस्य प्रभुमीशानं सर्वस्य शरणं सुहृत् ॥
verses.tr:
sarvendriyaguṇābhāsaṃ sarvendriyavivarjitam
sarvasya prabhumīśānaṃ sarvasya śaraṇaṃ suhṛt
verses.en: Separate from all the senses, yet reflecting the qualities of all the senses, it is the lord and ruler of all, it is the great refuge of all.

verses.sa:
नवद्वारे पुरे देही हंसो लेलायते बहिः ।
वशी सर्वस्य लोकस्य स्थावरस्य चरस्य च ॥
verses.tr:
navadvāre pure dehī haṃso lelāyate bahiḥ
vaśī sarvasya lokasya sthāvarasya carasya ca
verses.en: The embodied spirit within the town with nine gates, the bird, flutters outwards, the ruler of the whole world, of all that rests and of all that moves.

verses.sa:
अपाणिपादो जवनो ग्रहीता पश्यत्यचक्षुः स शृणोत्यकर्णः ।
स वेत्ति वेद्यं न च तस्यास्ति वेत्ता तमाहुरग्र्यं पुरुषं महान्तम् ॥
verses.tr:
apāṇipādo javano grahītā paśyatyacakṣuḥ sa śṛṇotyakarṇaḥ
sa vetti vedyaṃ na ca tasyāsti vettā tamāhuragryaṃ puruṣaṃ mahāntam
verses.en: Grasping without hands, hasting without feet, he sees without eyes, he hears without ears. He knows what can be known, but no one knows him; they call him the first, the great person (purusha).

verses.sa:
अणोरणीयान्महतो महीयानात्मा गुहायां निहितोऽस्य जन्तोः ।
तमक्रतुः पश्यति वीतशोको धातुः प्रसादान्महिमानमीशम् ॥
verses.tr:
aṇoraṇīyānmahato mahīyānātmā guhāyāṃ nihito'sya jantoḥ
tamakratuḥ paśyati vītaśoko dhātuḥ prasādānmahimānamīśam
verses.en: The Self, smaller than small, greater than great, is hidden in the heart of the creature. A man who has left all grief behind, sees the majesty, the Lord, the passionless, by the grace of the creator (the Lord).

verses.sa:
वेदाहमेतमजरं पुराणं सर्वात्मानं सर्वगतं विभुत्वात् ।
जन्मनिरोधं प्रवदन्ति यस्य ब्रह्मवादिनो हि प्रवदन्ति नित्यम् ॥
verses.tr:
vedāhametamajaraṃ purāṇaṃ sarvātmānaṃ sarvagataṃ vibhutvāt
janmanirodhaṃ pravadanti yasya brahmavādino hi pravadanti nityam
verses.en: I know this undecaying, ancient one, the self of all things, being infinite and omnipresent. They declare that in him all birth is stopped, for the Brahma-students proclaim him to be eternal.

sections.label: Fourth Adhyaya
sections.name: The one who rules every womb; two birds on one tree

verses.sa:
य एकोऽवर्णो बहुधा शक्तियोगाद्वर्णाननेकान्निहितार्थो दधाति ।
विचैति चान्ते विश्वमादौ च देवः स नो बुद्ध्या शुभया संयुनक्तु ॥
verses.tr:
ya eko'varṇo bahudhā śaktiyogādvarṇānanekānnihitārtho dadhāti
vicaiti cānte viśvamādau ca devaḥ sa no buddhyā śubhayā saṃyunaktu
verses.en: He, the sun, without any colour, who with set purpose by means of his power (sakti) produces endless colours, in whom all this comes together in the beginning, and comes asunder in the end—may he, the god, endow us with good thoughts.

verses.sa:
तदेवाग्निस्तदादित्यस्तद्वायुस्तदु चन्द्रमाः ।
तदेव शुक्रं तद्ब्रह्म तदापस्तत्प्रजापतिः ॥
verses.tr:
tadevāgnistadādityastadvāyustadu candramāḥ
tadeva śukraṃ tadbrahma tadāpastatprajāpatiḥ
verses.en: That (Self) indeed is Agni (fire), it is Aditya (sun), it is Vayu (wind), it is Chandramas (moon); the same also is the starry firmament, it is Brahman (Hiranyagarbha), it is water, it is Prajapati (Viraj).

verses.sa:
त्वं स्त्री पुमानसि त्वं कुमार उत वा कुमारी ।
त्वं जीर्णो दण्डेन वञ्चसि त्वं जातो भवसि विश्वतोमुखः ॥
verses.tr:
tvaṃ strī pumānasi tvaṃ kumāra uta vā kumārī
tvaṃ jīrṇo daṇḍena vañcasi tvaṃ jāto bhavasi viśvatomukhaḥ
verses.en: Thou art woman, thou art man; thou art youth, thou art maiden; thou, as an old man, totterest along on thy staff; thou art born with thy face turned everywhere.

verses.sa:
नीलः पतङ्गो हरितो लोहिताक्षस्तडिद्गर्भ ऋतवः समुद्राः ।
अनादिमत्त्वं विभुत्वेन वर्तसे यतो जातानि भुवनानि विश्वा ॥
verses.tr:
nīlaḥ pataṅgo harito lohitākṣastaḍidgarbha ṛtavaḥ samudrāḥ
anādimattvaṃ vibhutvena vartase yato jātāni bhuvanāni viśvā
verses.en: Thou art the dark-blue bee, thou art the green parrot with red eyes, thou art the thunder-cloud, the seasons, the seas. Thou art without beginning, because thou art infinite, thou from whom all worlds are born.

verses.sa:
अजामेकां लोहितशुक्लकृष्णां बह्वीः प्रजाः सृजमानां सरूपाः ।
अजो ह्येको जुषमाणोऽनुशेते जहात्येनां भुक्तभोगामजोऽन्यः ॥
verses.tr:
ajāmekāṃ lohitaśuklakṛṣṇāṃ bahvīḥ prajāḥ sṛjamānāṃ sarūpāḥ
ajo hyeko juṣamāṇo'nuśete jahātyenāṃ bhuktabhogāmajo'nyaḥ
verses.en: There is one unborn being (female), red, white, and black, uniform, but producing manifold offspring. There is one unborn being (male) who loves her and lies by her; there is another who leaves her, while she is eating what has to be eaten.

verses.sa:
द्वा सुपर्णा सयुजा सखाया समानं वृक्षं परिषस्वजाते ।
तयोरन्यः पिप्पलं स्वाद्वत्त्यनश्नन्नन्योऽभिचाकशीति ॥
verses.tr:
dvā suparṇā sayujā sakhāyā samānaṃ vṛkṣaṃ pariṣasvajāte
tayoranyaḥ pippalaṃ svādvattyanaśnannanyo'bhicākaśīti
verses.en: Two birds, inseparable friends, cling to the same tree. One of them eats the sweet fruit, the other looks on without eating.

verses.sa:
समाने वृक्षे पुरुषो निमग्नोऽनीशया शोचति मुह्यमानः ।
जुष्टं यदा पश्यत्यन्यमीशमस्य महिमानमिति वीतशोकः ॥
verses.tr:
samāne vṛkṣe puruṣo nimagno'nīśayā śocati muhyamānaḥ
juṣṭaṃ yadā paśyatyanyamīśamasya mahimānamiti vītaśokaḥ
verses.en: On the same tree man sits grieving, immersed, bewildered, by his own impotence (an-isa). But when he sees the other lord (isa) contented, and knows his glory, then his grief passes away.

verses.sa:
ऋचो अक्षरे परमे व्योमन्यस्मिन्देवा अधि विश्वे निषेदुः ।
यस्तं न वेद किमृचा करिष्यति य इत्तद्विदुस्त इमे समासते ॥
verses.tr:
ṛco akṣare parame vyomanyasmindevā adhi viśve niṣeduḥ
yastaṃ na veda kimṛcā kariṣyati ya ittadvidusta ime samāsate
verses.en: He who does not know that indestructible being of the Rig-veda, that highest ether-like (Self) wherein all the gods reside, of what use is the Rig-veda to him? Those only who know it, rest contented.

verses.sa:
छन्दांसि यज्ञाः क्रतवो व्रतानि भूतं भव्यं यच्च वेदा वदन्ति ।
अस्मान्मायी सृजते विश्वमेतत्तस्मिंश्चान्यो मायया सन्निरुद्धः ॥
verses.tr:
chandāṃsi yajñāḥ kratavo vratāni bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ yacca vedā vadanti
asmānmāyī sṛjate viśvametattasmiṃścānyo māyayā sanniruddhaḥ
verses.en: That from which the maker (mayin) sends forth all this—the sacred verses, the offerings, the sacrifices, the panaceas, the past, the future, and all that the Vedas declare—in that the other is bound up through that maya.

verses.sa:
मायां तु प्रकृतिं विद्यान्मायिनं च महेश्वरम् ।
तस्यावयवभूतैस्तु व्याप्तं सर्वमिदं जगत् ॥
verses.tr:
māyāṃ tu prakṛtiṃ vidyānmāyinaṃ ca maheśvaram
tasyāvayavabhūtaistu vyāptaṃ sarvamidaṃ jagat
verses.en: Know then Prakriti (nature) is Maya (art), and the great Lord the Mayin (maker); the whole world is filled with what are his members.

verses.sa:
यो योनिं योनिमधितिष्ठत्येको यस्मिन्निदं सं च विचैति सर्वम् ।
तमीशानं वरदं देवमीड्यं निचाय्येमां शान्तिमत्यन्तमेति ॥
verses.tr:
yo yoniṃ yonimadhitiṣṭhatyeko yasminnidaṃ saṃ ca vicaiti sarvam
tamīśānaṃ varadaṃ devamīḍyaṃ nicāyyemāṃ śāntimatyantameti
verses.en: If a man has discerned him, who being one only, rules over every germ (cause), in whom all this comes together and comes asunder again, who is the lord, the bestower of blessing, the adorable god, then he passes for ever into that peace.

verses.sa:
यो देवानां प्रभवश्चोद्भवश्च विश्वाधिपो रुद्रो महर्षिः ।
हिरण्यगर्भं पश्यत जायमानं स नो बुद्ध्या शुभया संयुनक्तु ॥
verses.tr:
yo devānāṃ prabhavaścodbhavaśca viśvādhipo rudro maharṣiḥ
hiraṇyagarbhaṃ paśyata jāyamānaṃ sa no buddhyā śubhayā saṃyunaktu
verses.en: He, the creator and supporter of the gods, Rudra, the great seer, the lord of all, who saw Hiranyagarbha being born, may he endow us with good thoughts.

verses.sa:
यो देवानामधिपो यस्मिन्ल्लोका अधिश्रिताः ।
य ईशेऽस्य द्विपदश्चतुष्पदः कस्मै देवाय हविषा विधेम ॥
verses.tr:
yo devānāmadhipo yasminllokā adhiśritāḥ
ya īśe'sya dvipadaścatuṣpadaḥ kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema
verses.en: He who is the sovereign of the gods, he in whom all the worlds rest, he who rules over all two-footed and four-footed beings, to that god let us sacrifice an oblation.

verses.sa:
सूक्ष्मातिसूक्ष्मं कलिलस्य मध्ये विश्वस्य स्रष्टारमनेकरूपम् ।
विश्वस्यैकं परिवेष्टितारं ज्ञात्वा शिवं शान्तिमत्यन्तमेति ॥
verses.tr:
sūkṣmātisūkṣmaṃ kalilasya madhye viśvasya sraṣṭāramanekarūpam
viśvasyaikaṃ pariveṣṭitāraṃ jñātvā śivaṃ śāntimatyantameti
verses.en: He who has known him who is more subtile than subtile, in the midst of chaos, creating all things, having many forms, alone enveloping everything, the happy one (Siva), passes into peace for ever.

verses.sa:
स एव काले भुवनस्य गोप्ता विश्वाधिपः सर्वभूतेषु गूढः ।
यस्मिन्युक्ता ब्रह्मर्षयो देवताश्च तमेवं ज्ञात्वा मृत्युपाशांश्छिनत्ति ॥
verses.tr:
sa eva kāle bhuvanasya goptā viśvādhipaḥ sarvabhūteṣu gūḍhaḥ
yasminyuktā brahmarṣayo devatāśca tamevaṃ jñātvā mṛtyupāśāṃśchinatti
verses.en: He also was in time the guardian of this world, the lord of all, hidden in all beings. In him the Brahmarshis and the deities are united, and he who knows him cuts the fetters of death asunder.

verses.sa:
घृतात्परं मण्डमिवातिसूक्ष्मं ज्ञात्वा शिवं सर्वभूतेषु गूढम् ।
विश्वस्यैकं परिवेष्टितारं ज्ञात्वा देवं मुच्यते सर्वपाशैः ॥
verses.tr:
ghṛtātparaṃ maṇḍamivātisūkṣmaṃ jñātvā śivaṃ sarvabhūteṣu gūḍham
viśvasyaikaṃ pariveṣṭitāraṃ jñātvā devaṃ mucyate sarvapāśaiḥ
verses.en: He who knows Siva (the blessed) hidden in all beings, like the subtile film that rises from out the clarified butter, alone enveloping everything,—he who knows the god, is freed from all fetters.

verses.sa:
एष देवो विश्वकर्मा महात्मा सदा जनानां हृदये सन्निविष्टः ।
हृदा मनीषा मनसाभिक्लृप्तो य एतद् विदुरमृतास्ते भवन्ति ॥
verses.tr:
eṣa devo viśvakarmā mahātmā sadā janānāṃ hṛdaye sanniviṣṭaḥ
hṛdā manīṣā manasābhiklṛpto ya etad viduramṛtāste bhavanti
verses.en: That god, the maker of all things, the great Self, always dwelling in the heart of man, is perceived by the heart, the soul, the mind;—they who know it become immortal.

verses.sa:
यदाऽतमस्तन्न दिवा न रात्रिर्न सन्न चासच्छिव एव केवलः ।
तदक्षरं तत्सवितुर्वरेण्यं प्रज्ञा च तस्मात्प्रसृता पुराणी ॥
verses.tr:
yadā'tamastanna divā na rātrirna sanna cāsacchiva eva kevalaḥ
tadakṣaraṃ tatsaviturvareṇyaṃ prajñā ca tasmātprasṛtā purāṇī
verses.en: When the light has risen, there is no day, no night, neither existence nor non-existence; Siva (the blessed) alone is there. That is the eternal, the adorable light of Savitri,—and the ancient wisdom proceeded thence.

verses.sa:
नैनमूर्ध्वं न तिर्यञ्चं न मध्ये न परिजग्रभत् ।
न तस्य प्रतिमा अस्ति यस्य नाम महद्यशः ॥
verses.tr:
nainamūrdhvaṃ na tiryañcaṃ na madhye na parijagrabhat
na tasya pratimā asti yasya nāma mahadyaśaḥ
verses.en: No one has grasped him above, or across, or in the middle. There is no image of him whose name is Great Glory.

verses.sa:
न संदृशे तिष्ठति रूपमस्य न चक्षुषा पश्यति कश्चनैनम् ।
हृदा हृदिस्थं मनसा य एनमेवं विदुरमृतास्ते भवन्ति ॥
verses.tr:
na saṃdṛśe tiṣṭhati rūpamasya na cakṣuṣā paśyati kaścanainam
hṛdā hṛdisthaṃ manasā ya enamevaṃ viduramṛtāste bhavanti
verses.en: His form cannot be seen, no one perceives him with the eye. Those who through heart and mind know him thus abiding in the heart, become immortal.

verses.sa:
अजात इत्येवं कश्चिद्भीरुः प्रपद्यते ।
रुद्र यत्ते दक्षिणं मुखं तेन मां पाहि नित्यम् ॥
verses.tr:
ajāta ityevaṃ kaścidbhīruḥ prapadyate
rudra yatte dakṣiṇaṃ mukhaṃ tena māṃ pāhi nityam
verses.en: 'Thou art unborn,' with these words some one comes near to thee, trembling. O Rudra, let thy gracious face protect me for ever!

verses.sa:
मा नस्तोके तनये मा न आयुषि मा नो गोषु मा न अश्वेषु रीरिषः ।
वीरान् मा नो रुद्र भामितोऽवधीर्हविष्मन्तः सदामित्त्वा हवामहे ॥
verses.tr:
mā nastoke tanaye mā na āyuṣi mā no goṣu mā na aśveṣu rīriṣaḥ
vīrān mā no rudra bhāmito'vadhīrhaviṣmantaḥ sadāmittvā havāmahe
verses.en: O Rudra! hurt us not in our offspring and descendants, hurt us not in our own lives, nor in our cows, nor in our horses! Do not slay our men in thy wrath, for, holding oblations, we call on thee always.

sections.label: Fifth Adhyaya
sections.name: Knowledge and ignorance; the soul and its bodies

verses.sa:
द्वे अक्षरे ब्रह्मपरे त्वनन्ते विद्याविद्ये निहिते यत्र गूढे ।
क्षरं त्वविद्यां ह्यमृतं तु विद्या विद्याविद्ये ईशते यस्तु सोऽन्यः ॥
verses.tr:
dve akṣare brahmapare tvanante vidyāvidye nihite yatra gūḍhe
kṣaraṃ tvavidyāṃ hyamṛtaṃ tu vidyā vidyāvidye īśate yastu so'nyaḥ
verses.en: In the imperishable and infinite Highest Brahman, wherein the two, knowledge and ignorance, are hidden, the one, ignorance, perishes, the other, knowledge, is immortal; but he who controls both, knowledge and ignorance, is another.

verses.sa:
यो योनिं योनिमधितिष्ठत्येको विश्वानि रूपाणि योनीश्च सर्वाः ।
ऋषिं प्रसूतं कपिलं यस्तमग्रे ज्ञानैर्बिभर्ति जायमानं च पश्येत् ॥
verses.tr:
yo yoniṃ yonimadhitiṣṭhatyeko viśvāni rūpāṇi yonīśca sarvāḥ
ṛṣiṃ prasūtaṃ kapilaṃ yastamagre jñānairbibharti jāyamānaṃ ca paśyet
verses.en: It is he who, being one only, rules over every germ (cause), over all forms, and over all germs; it is he who, in the beginning, bears in his thoughts the wise son, the fiery, whom he wishes to look on while he is born.

verses.sa:
एकैकं जालं बहुधा विकुर्वन्नस्मिन्क्षेत्रे संहरत्येष देवः ।
भूयः सृष्ट्वा पतयस्तथेशः सर्वाधिपत्यं कुरुते महात्मा ॥
verses.tr:
ekaikaṃ jālaṃ bahudhā vikurvannasminkṣetre saṃharatyeṣa devaḥ
bhūyaḥ sṛṣṭvā patayastatheśaḥ sarvādhipatyaṃ kurute mahātmā
verses.en: In that field in which the god, after spreading out one net after another in various ways, draws it together again, the Lord, the great Self, having further created the lords, thus carries on his lordship over all.

verses.sa:
सर्वा दिश ऊर्ध्वमधश्च तिर्यक्प्रकाशयन्भ्राजते यद्वनड्वान् ।
एवं स देवो भगवान्वरेण्यो योनिस्वभावानधितिष्ठत्येकः ॥
verses.tr:
sarvā diśa ūrdhvamadhaśca tiryakprakāśayanbhrājate yadvanaḍvān
evaṃ sa devo bhagavānvareṇyo yonisvabhāvānadhitiṣṭhatyekaḥ
verses.en: As the car (of the sun) shines, lighting up all quarters, above, below, and across, thus does that god, the holy, the adorable, being one, rule over all that has the nature of a germ.

verses.sa:
यच्च स्वभावं पचति विश्वयोनिः पाच्यांश्च सर्वान् परिणामयेद्यः ।
सर्वमेतद्विश्वमधितिष्ठत्येको गुणांश्च सर्वान्विनियोजयेद्यः ॥
verses.tr:
yacca svabhāvaṃ pacati viśvayoniḥ pācyāṃśca sarvān pariṇāmayedyaḥ
sarvametadviśvamadhitiṣṭhatyeko guṇāṃśca sarvānviniyojayedyaḥ
verses.en: He, being one, rules over all and everything, so that the universal germ ripens its nature, diversifies all natures that can be ripened, and determines all qualities.

verses.sa:
तद्वेदगुह्योपनिषत्सु गूढं तद्ब्रह्मा वेदते ब्रह्मयोनिम् ।
ये पूर्वं देवा ऋषयश्च तद्विदुस्ते तन्मया अमृता वै बभूवुः ॥
verses.tr:
tadvedaguhyopaniṣatsu gūḍhaṃ tadbrahmā vedate brahmayonim
ye pūrvaṃ devā ṛṣayaśca tadviduste tanmayā amṛtā vai babhūvuḥ
verses.en: Brahma (Hiranyagarbha) knows this, which is hidden in the Upanishads, which are hidden in the Vedas, as the Brahma-germ. The ancient gods and poets who knew it, they became it and were immortal.

verses.sa:
गुणान्वयो यः फलकर्मकर्ता कृतस्य तस्यैव स चोपभोक्ता ।
स विश्वरूपस्त्रिगुणस्त्रिवर्त्मा प्राणाधिपः सञ्चरति स्वकर्मभिः ॥
verses.tr:
guṇānvayo yaḥ phalakarmakartā kṛtasya tasyaiva sa copabhoktā
sa viśvarūpastriguṇastrivartmā prāṇādhipaḥ sañcarati svakarmabhiḥ
verses.en: But he who is endowed with qualities, and performs works that are to bear fruit, and enjoys the reward of whatever he has done, migrates through his own works, the lord of life, assuming all forms, led by the three Gunas, and following the three paths.

verses.sa:
अङ्गुष्ठमात्रो रवितुल्यरूपः सङ्कल्पाहङ्कारसमन्वितो यः ।
बुद्धेर्गुणेनात्मगुणेन चैव आराग्रमात्रोऽप्यपरोऽपि दृष्टः ॥
verses.tr:
aṅguṣṭhamātro ravitulyarūpaḥ saṅkalpāhaṅkārasamanvito yaḥ
buddherguṇenātmaguṇena caiva ārāgramātro'pyaparo'pi dṛṣṭaḥ
verses.en: That lower one also, not larger than a thumb, but brilliant like the sun, who is endowed with personality and thoughts, with the quality of mind and the quality of body, is seen small even like the point of a goad.

verses.sa:
बालाग्रशतभागस्य शतधा कल्पितस्य च ।
भागो जीवः स विज्ञेयः स चानन्त्याय कल्पते ॥
verses.tr:
bālāgraśatabhāgasya śatadhā kalpitasya ca
bhāgo jīvaḥ sa vijñeyaḥ sa cānantyāya kalpate
verses.en: That living soul is to be known as part of the hundredth part of the point of a hair, divided a hundred times, and yet it is to be infinite.

verses.sa:
नैव स्त्री न पुमानेष न चैवायं नपुंसकः ।
यद्यच्छरीरमादत्ते तेन तेन स युज्यते ॥
verses.tr:
naiva strī na pumāneṣa na caivāyaṃ napuṃsakaḥ
yadyaccharīramādatte tena tena sa yujyate
verses.en: It is not woman, it is not man, nor is it neuter; whatever body it takes, with that it is joined (only).

verses.sa:
सङ्कल्पनस्पर्शनदृष्टिमोहैर्ग्रासांबुवृष्ट्यात्मविवृद्धिजन्म ।
कर्मानुगान्यनुक्रमेण देही स्थानेषु रूपाण्यभिसम्प्रपद्यते ॥
verses.tr:
saṅkalpanasparśanadṛṣṭimohairgrāsāṃbuvṛṣṭyātmavivṛddhijanma
karmānugānyanukrameṇa dehī sthāneṣu rūpāṇyabhisamprapadyate
verses.en: By means of thoughts, touching, seeing, and passions the incarnate Self assumes successively in various places various forms, in accordance with his deeds, just as the body grows when food and drink are poured into it.

verses.sa:
स्थूलानि सूक्ष्माणि बहूनि चैव रूपाणि देही स्वगुणैर्वृणोति ।
क्रियागुणैरात्मगुणैश्च तेषां संयोगहेतुरपरोऽपि दृष्टः ॥
verses.tr:
sthūlāni sūkṣmāṇi bahūni caiva rūpāṇi dehī svaguṇairvṛṇoti
kriyāguṇairātmaguṇaiśca teṣāṃ saṃyogaheturaparo'pi dṛṣṭaḥ
verses.en: That incarnate Self, according to his own qualities, chooses (assumes) many shapes, coarse or subtile, and having himself caused his union with them, he is seen as another and another, through the qualities of his acts, and through the qualities of his body.

verses.sa:
अनाद्यनन्तं कलिलस्य मध्ये विश्वस्य स्रष्टारमनेकरूपम् ।
विश्वस्यैकं परिवेष्टितारं ज्ञात्वा देवं मुच्यते सर्वपाशैः ॥
verses.tr:
anādyanantaṃ kalilasya madhye viśvasya sraṣṭāramanekarūpam
viśvasyaikaṃ pariveṣṭitāraṃ jñātvā devaṃ mucyate sarvapāśaiḥ
verses.en: He who knows him who has no beginning and no end, in the midst of chaos, creating all things, having many forms, alone enveloping everything, is freed from all fetters.

verses.sa:
भावग्राह्यमनीडाख्यं भावाभावकरं शिवम् ।
कलासर्गकरं देवं ये विदुस्ते जहुस्तनुम् ॥
verses.tr:
bhāvagrāhyamanīḍākhyaṃ bhāvābhāvakaraṃ śivam
kalāsargakaraṃ devaṃ ye viduste jahustanum
verses.en: Those who know him who is to be grasped by the mind, who is not to be called the nest (the body), who makes existence and non-existence, the happy one (Siva), who also creates the elements, they have left the body.

sections.label: Sixth Adhyaya
sections.name: The greatness of God; the highest devotion

verses.sa:
स्वभावमेके कवयो वदन्ति कालं तथान्ये परिमुह्यमानाः ।
देवस्यैष महिमा तु लोके येनेदं भ्राम्यते ब्रह्मचक्रम् ॥
verses.tr:
svabhāvameke kavayo vadanti kālaṃ tathānye parimuhyamānāḥ
devasyaiṣa mahimā tu loke yenedaṃ bhrāmyate brahmacakram
verses.en: Some wise men, deluded, speak of Nature, and others of Time (as the cause of everything); but it is the greatness of God by which this Brahma-wheel is made to turn.

verses.sa:
येनावृतं नित्यमिदं हि सर्वं ज्ञः कालकारो गुणी सर्वविद्यः ।
तेनेशितं कर्म विवर्तते ह पृथिव्यप्तेजोनिलखानि चिन्त्यम् ॥
verses.tr:
yenāvṛtaṃ nityamidaṃ hi sarvaṃ jñaḥ kālakāro guṇī sarvavidyaḥ
teneśitaṃ karma vivartate ha pṛthivyaptejonilakhāni cintyam
verses.en: It is at the command of him who always covers this world, the knower, the time of time, who assumes qualities and all knowledge, it is at his command that this work (creation) unfolds itself, which is called earth, water, fire, air, and ether;

verses.sa:
तत्कर्म कृत्वा विनिवर्त्य भूयस्तत्त्वस्य तत्त्वेन समेत्य योगम् ।
एकेन द्वाभ्यां त्रिभिरष्टभिर्वा कालेन चैवात्मगुणैश्च सूक्ष्मैः ॥
verses.tr:
tatkarma kṛtvā vinivartya bhūyastattvasya tattvena sametya yogam
ekena dvābhyāṃ tribhiraṣṭabhirvā kālena caivātmaguṇaiśca sūkṣmaiḥ
verses.en: He who, after he has done that work and rested again, and after he has brought together one essence (the self) with the other (matter), with one, two, three, or eight, with time also and with the subtile qualities of the mind,

verses.sa:
आरभ्य कर्माणि गुणान्वितानि भावांश्च सर्वान् विनियोजयेद्यः ।
तेषामभावे कृतकर्मनाशः कर्मक्षये याति स तत्त्वतोऽन्यः ॥
verses.tr:
ārabhya karmāṇi guṇānvitāni bhāvāṃśca sarvān viniyojayedyaḥ
teṣāmabhāve kṛtakarmanāśaḥ karmakṣaye yāti sa tattvato'nyaḥ
verses.en: Who, after starting the works endowed with (the three) qualities, can order all things, yet when, in the absence of all these, he has caused the destruction of the work, goes on, being in truth different (from all he has produced);

verses.sa:
आदिः स संयोगनिमित्तहेतुः परस्त्रिकालादकलोऽपि दृष्टः ।
तं विश्वरूपं भवभूतमीड्यं देवं स्वचित्तस्थमुपास्य पूर्वम् ॥
verses.tr:
ādiḥ sa saṃyoganimittahetuḥ parastrikālādakalo'pi dṛṣṭaḥ
taṃ viśvarūpaṃ bhavabhūtamīḍyaṃ devaṃ svacittasthamupāsya pūrvam
verses.en: He is the beginning, producing the causes which unite (the soul with the body), and, being above the three kinds of time (past, present, future), he is seen as without parts after we have first worshipped that adorable god, who has many forms, and who is the true source (of all things), as dwelling in our own mind.

verses.sa:
स वृक्षकालाकृतिभिः परोऽन्यो यस्मात्प्रपञ्चः परिवर्ततेऽयम् ।
धर्मावहं पापनुदं भगेशं ज्ञात्वात्मस्थममृतं विश्वधाम ॥
verses.tr:
sa vṛkṣakālākṛtibhiḥ paro'nyo yasmātprapañcaḥ parivartate'yam
dharmāvahaṃ pāpanudaṃ bhageśaṃ jñātvātmasthamamṛtaṃ viśvadhāma
verses.en: He is beyond all the forms of the tree (of the world) and of time, he is the other, from whom this world moves round, when one has known him who brings good and removes evil, the lord of bliss, as dwelling within the self, the immortal, the support of all.

verses.sa:
तमीश्वराणां परमं महेश्वरं तं देवतानां परमं च दैवतम् ।
पतिं पतीनां परमं परस्ताद्विदाम देवं भुवनेशमीड्यम् ॥
verses.tr:
tamīśvarāṇāṃ paramaṃ maheśvaraṃ taṃ devatānāṃ paramaṃ ca daivatam
patiṃ patīnāṃ paramaṃ parastādvidāma devaṃ bhuvaneśamīḍyam
verses.en: Let us know that highest great lord of lords, the highest deity of deities, the master of masters, the highest above, as god, the lord of the world, the adorable.

verses.sa:
न तस्य कार्यं करणं च विद्यते न तत्समश्चाभ्यधिकश्च दृश्यते ।
परास्य शक्तिर्विविधैव श्रूयते स्वाभाविकी ज्ञानबलक्रिया च ॥
verses.tr:
na tasya kāryaṃ karaṇaṃ ca vidyate na tatsamaścābhyadhikaśca dṛśyate
parāsya śaktirvividhaiva śrūyate svābhāvikī jñānabalakriyā ca
verses.en: There is no effect and no cause known of him, no one is seen like unto him or better; his high power is revealed as manifold, as inherent, acting as force and knowledge.

verses.sa:
न तस्य कश्चित्पतिरस्ति लोके न चेशिता नैव च तस्य लिङ्गम् ।
स कारणं करणाधिपाधिपो न चास्य कश्चिज्जनिता न चाधिपः ॥
verses.tr:
na tasya kaścitpatirasti loke na ceśitā naiva ca tasya liṅgam
sa kāraṇaṃ karaṇādhipādhipo na cāsya kaścijjanitā na cādhipaḥ
verses.en: There is no master of his in the world, no ruler of his, not even a sign of him. He is the cause, the lord of the lords of the organs, and there is of him neither parent nor lord.

verses.sa:
यस्तन्तुनाभ इव तन्तुभिः प्रधानजैः स्वभावतः ।
देव एकः स्वमावृणोति स नो दधातु ब्रह्माप्ययम् ॥
verses.tr:
yastantunābha iva tantubhiḥ pradhānajaiḥ svabhāvataḥ
deva ekaḥ svamāvṛṇoti sa no dadhātu brahmāpyayam
verses.en: That only god who spontaneously covered himself, like a spider, with threads drawn from the first cause (pradhana), grant us entrance into Brahman.

verses.sa:
एको देवः सर्वभूतेषु गूढः सर्वव्यापी सर्वभूतान्तरात्मा ।
कर्माध्यक्षः सर्वभूताधिवासः साक्षी चेता केवलो निर्गुणश्च ॥
verses.tr:
eko devaḥ sarvabhūteṣu gūḍhaḥ sarvavyāpī sarvabhūtāntarātmā
karmādhyakṣaḥ sarvabhūtādhivāsaḥ sākṣī cetā kevalo nirguṇaśca
verses.en: He is the one God, hidden in all beings, all-pervading, the self within all beings, watching over all works, dwelling in all beings, the witness, the perceiver, the only one, free from qualities.

verses.sa:
एको वशी निष्क्रियाणां बहूनामेकं बीजं बहुधा यः करोति ।
तमात्मस्थं येऽनुपश्यन्ति धीरास्तेषां सुखं शाश्वतं नेतरेषाम् ॥
verses.tr:
eko vaśī niṣkriyāṇāṃ bahūnāmekaṃ bījaṃ bahudhā yaḥ karoti
tamātmasthaṃ ye'nupaśyanti dhīrāsteṣāṃ sukhaṃ śāśvataṃ netareṣām
verses.en: He is the one ruler of many who (seem to act, but really do) not act; he makes the one seed manifold. The wise who perceive him within their self, to them belongs eternal happiness, not to others.

verses.sa:
नित्यो नित्यानां चेतनश्चेतनानामेको बहूनां यो विदधाति कामान् ।
तत्कारणं सांख्ययोगाधिगम्यं ज्ञात्वा देवं मुच्यते सर्वपाशैः ॥
verses.tr:
nityo nityānāṃ cetanaścetanānāmeko bahūnāṃ yo vidadhāti kāmān
tatkāraṇaṃ sāṃkhyayogādhigamyaṃ jñātvā devaṃ mucyate sarvapāśaiḥ
verses.en: He is the eternal among eternals, the thinker among thinkers, who, though one, fulfils the desires of many. He who has known that cause which is to be apprehended by Sankhya (philosophy) and Yoga (religious discipline), he is freed from all fetters.

verses.sa:
न तत्र सूर्यो भाति न चन्द्रतारकं नेमा विद्युतो भान्ति कुतोऽयमग्निः ।
तमेव भान्तमनुभाति सर्वं तस्य भासा सर्वमिदं विभाति ॥
verses.tr:
na tatra sūryo bhāti na candratārakaṃ nemā vidyuto bhānti kuto'yamagniḥ
tameva bhāntamanubhāti sarvaṃ tasya bhāsā sarvamidaṃ vibhāti
verses.en: The sun does not shine there, nor the moon and the stars, nor these lightnings, and much less this fire. When he shines, everything shines after him; by his light all this is lightened.

verses.sa:
एको हंसो भुवनस्यास्य मध्ये स एवाग्निः सलिले संनिविष्टः ।
तमेव विदित्वातिमृत्युमेति नान्यः पन्था विद्यतेऽयनाय ॥
verses.tr:
eko haṃso bhuvanasyāsya madhye sa evāgniḥ salile saṃniviṣṭaḥ
tameva viditvātimṛtyumeti nānyaḥ panthā vidyate'yanāya
verses.en: He is the one bird in the midst of the world; he is also (like) the fire (of the sun) that has set in the ocean. A man who knows him truly, passes over death; there is no other path to go.

verses.sa:
स विश्वकृद् विश्वविदात्मयोनिर्ज्ञः कालकालो गुणी सर्वविद्यः ।
प्रधानक्षेत्रज्ञपतिर्गुणेशः संसारमोक्षस्थितिबन्धहेतुः ॥
verses.tr:
sa viśvakṛd viśvavidātmayonirjñaḥ kālakālo guṇī sarvavidyaḥ
pradhānakṣetrajñapatirguṇeśaḥ saṃsāramokṣasthitibandhahetuḥ
verses.en: He makes all, he knows all, the self-caused, the knower, the time of time (destroyer of time), who assumes qualities and knows everything, the master of nature and of man, the lord of the three qualities (gunas), the cause of the bondage, the existence, and the liberation of the world.

verses.sa:
स तन्मयो ह्यमृत ईशसंस्थो ज्ञः सर्वगो भुवनस्यास्य गोप्ता ।
य ईशेऽस्य जगतो नित्यमेव नान्यो हेतुर्विद्यत ईशनाय ॥
verses.tr:
sa tanmayo hyamṛta īśasaṃstho jñaḥ sarvago bhuvanasyāsya goptā
ya īśe'sya jagato nityameva nānyo heturvidyata īśanāya
verses.en: He who has become that, he is the immortal, remaining the lord, the knower, the ever-present guardian of this world, who rules this world for ever, for no one else is able to rule it.

verses.sa:
यो ब्रह्माणं विदधाति पूर्वं यो वै वेदांश्च प्रहिणोति तस्मै ।
तं ह देवमात्मबुद्धिप्रकाशं मुमुक्षुर्वै शरणमहं प्रपद्ये ॥
verses.tr:
yo brahmāṇaṃ vidadhāti pūrvaṃ yo vai vedāṃśca prahiṇoti tasmai
taṃ ha devamātmabuddhiprakāśaṃ mumukṣurvai śaraṇamahaṃ prapadye
verses.en: Seeking for freedom I go for refuge to that God who is the light of his own thoughts, he who first creates Brahman (m.) and delivers the Vedas to him;

verses.sa:
निष्कलं निष्क्रियं शान्तं निरवद्यं निरञ्जनम् ।
अमृतस्य परं सेतुं दग्धेन्धनमिवानलम् ॥
verses.tr:
niṣkalaṃ niṣkriyaṃ śāntaṃ niravadyaṃ nirañjanam
amṛtasya paraṃ setuṃ dagdhendhanamivānalam
verses.en: Who is without parts, without actions, tranquil, without fault, without taint, the highest bridge to immortality—like a fire that has consumed its fuel.

verses.sa:
यदा चर्मवदाकाशं वेष्टयिष्यन्ति मानवाः ।
तदा देवमविज्ञाय दुःखस्यान्तो भविष्यति ॥
verses.tr:
yadā carmavadākāśaṃ veṣṭayiṣyanti mānavāḥ
tadā devamavijñāya duḥkhasyānto bhaviṣyati
verses.en: Only when men shall roll up the sky like a hide, will there be an end of misery, unless God has first been known.

verses.sa:
तपःप्रभावाद् देवप्रसादाच्च ब्रह्म ह श्वेताश्वतरोऽथ विद्वान् ।
अत्याश्रमिभ्यः परमं पवित्रं प्रोवाच सम्यगृषिसङ्घजुष्टम् ॥
verses.tr:
tapaḥprabhāvād devaprasādācca brahma ha śvetāśvataro'tha vidvān
atyāśramibhyaḥ paramaṃ pavitraṃ provāca samyagṛṣisaṅghajuṣṭam
verses.en: Through the power of his penance and through the grace of God has the wise Svetasvatara truly proclaimed Brahman, the highest and holiest, to the best of ascetics, as approved by the company of Rishis.

verses.sa:
वेदान्ते परमं गुह्यं पुराकल्पे प्रचोदितम् ।
नाप्रशान्ताय दातव्यं नापुत्रायाशिष्याय वा पुनः ॥
verses.tr:
vedānte paramaṃ guhyaṃ purākalpe pracoditam
nāpraśāntāya dātavyaṃ nāputrāyāśiṣyāya vā punaḥ
verses.en: This highest mystery in the Vedanta, delivered in a former age, should not be given to one whose passions have not been subdued, nor to one who is not a son, or who is not a pupil.

verses.sa:
यस्य देवे परा भक्तिः यथा देवे तथा गुरौ ।
तस्यैते कथिता ह्यर्थाः प्रकाशन्ते महात्मनः ।
प्रकाशन्ते महात्मन इति ॥
verses.tr:
yasya deve parā bhaktiḥ yathā deve tathā gurau
tasyaite kathitā hyarthāḥ prakāśante mahātmanaḥ
prakāśante mahātmana iti
verses.en: If these truths have been told to a high-minded man, who feels the highest devotion for God, and for his Guru as for God, then they will shine forth,—then they will shine forth indeed.
